protocol.hypothesis: More independent classic-teacher roots improve a fixed conditional linear/FM learner on the same 100-root family holdout.
protocol.baselineReuse: Exact unchanged v46 training and selection observations and trainers; current native code differs only in collection risk admission, not fitting or inference.
protocol.dataSelection: Frozen stopped r6 corpus, classic roll-in only; exclude complete internal holdout families and near decks; nested balanced prefixes. Never select using quality labels or validation outcomes.
protocol.comparisonCaveat: New collection seed also changes encountered builds; this is a practical data-coverage curve, not replicated random-subset causal estimation.
protocol.selectionRule: Minimum character -> encounter family -> root mean clipped pair log-loss over the fixed 100 roots. Exact tie prefers fewer roots, then linear. One global candidate, no role-head selection.
protocol.fullFitGate: Only an augmented candidate beating the best reused 276-root candidate receives one full refit, parity test and outer development search.

eligibility.rootIdentityChecks: Both full root stamps hashed; no exact duplicate across 376 old and admitted new roots.
